scientific_question: When the accepted-at-5TPP QK+c_fc composition erodes after 10TPP, does the same-run task geometry identify intrinsic c_fc drift, dense c_proj context drift, or a harmful c_fc/c_proj interaction?

factorial_design.context: all non-MLP-pair parameters remain at the current phase
factorial_design.factor_a: mlp.c_fc weight from 5TPP reference or current phase
factorial_design.factor_b: mlp.c_proj weight from 5TPP reference or current phase

classification_order: PHASE_POST_GELU_CONVERSION_DRIFT if late-band conversion ratio at 7119 is <=0.90 while pre-GELU hard-rank ratio is >=0.90
PHASE_PRE_GELU_CAPACITY_DRIFT if late-band pre-GELU hard-rank ratio at 7119 is <=0.90
PHASE_RESIDUAL_BRANCH_SCALE_DRIFT if late-band update/residual RMS ratio at 7119 is outside [0.90,1.10]
COADAPTED_RESIDUAL_DIRECTION_DRIFT if late-band cosine shift is >=0.02 and the 2x2 interaction is >=+0.005 CE
CFC_INTRINSIC_DIRECTION_DRIFT if late-band cosine shift is >=0.02 and the c_fc main effect with reference c_proj is >=+0.005 CE
CPROJ_CONTEXT_DIRECTION_DRIFT if late-band cosine shift is >=0.02 and the c_proj main effect with reference c_fc is >=+0.005 CE
DIRECTION_DRIFT_WITHOUT_TASK_FACTORIAL_PENALTY if only the cosine threshold is crossed
decision_rule.earliest_direction_shift: first post-5TPP phase whose late-band mean absolute residual/update cosine shift reaches 0.02

theory_reconciliation.mapping_theorem: The theorem is local and existential, so raw Euclidean low rank is insufficient; the analysis must test the learned path in the task metric.
theory_reconciliation.lwt: Layer-specific manifolds motivate per-layer activation and residual-write measurements rather than one global latent conclusion.
theory_reconciliation.terminal_evidence: The terminal audit found preserved pre/post-GELU rank and update scale but a material late-layer residual-direction shift.
theory_reconciliation.factorial_reason: Same-run c_fc/c_proj recombination directly tests whether the procedural feature path is intrinsically harmful or only harmful through its co-adapted dense writer.
theory_reconciliation.pca_boundary: Five-point raw c_fc and c_proj PCA/path statistics are descriptive trajectory summaries with rank upper bound four, never estimates of ambient manifold dimension or structure-selection evidence alone.

systems.expected_duration: under five minutes based on the 31-second two-checkpoint terminal audit and the small fixed-token factorial
systems.mfu_gate: not applicable to a zero-update analysis
